name: envia TEL Datacenter Chemnitz
notes: DataCenterMap lists Datacenter Chemnitz by envia TEL at Chemnitztalstraße 13; STULZ supplier case study also says envia TEL has a Chemnitz site in addition to its Taucha/Leipzig data center.

name: ALL-INKL.COM Dresden data centres
notes: Official ALL-INKL page says it operates several own data centres located in Dresden, with space for well over 15,000 servers and 100% hydroelectric power.

name: TU Dresden Lehmann Center Data Center (LZR)
notes: Official TU Dresden page describes the Lehmann Center data center as designed for up to 5 MW electrical power and more than 1,200 sqm of computer-room space for central IT and supercomputers.

name: TU Dresden Deneb HPC system at Lehmann Center
notes: TU Dresden says Deneb will be installed at the Lehmann Center with user operation from Q4 2026; DCD also reported the planned Nvidia Grace Blackwell system in January 2026.

name: Comarch Dresden Data Center
notes: Official Comarch page lists a Dresden data center at Chemnitzer Str. 59b offering managed services, cloud hosting, colocation, disaster recovery, and backup; third-party platform reports 1,143 sqm and 2.4 MW connection capacity.

name: Arelion Dresden
notes: DataCenterMap lists Arelion Dresden at Overbeckstr. 41a; Arelion's European network map also lists Dresden, Overbeckstr. 41a as an Arelion location.

name: PlusServer Dresden
notes: DataCenterMap lists PlusServer Dresden at Annenstr. 5 with redundant power and Internet connectivity for racks.

name: EXA Marie Curie Dresden
notes: Third-party data center directories list EXA Marie Curie at Marie-Curie-Straße 7 in Dresden-Pieschen.

name: German Center for Astrophysics International Astrophysics Data Center
developer: Deutsches Zentrum für Astrophysik (DZA) / TU Dresden partners
notes: DZA is being built in Lusatia with a Görlitz institute; public project descriptions include an International Astrophysics Data Center, and a 2025 job posting covered establishment and management of a modern astronomical data center at DZA.

name: Green Power Park Lobstädt / Neukieritzsch data center
developer: PV Backoffice GmbH / Green Power Park Lobstädt GmbH i.G.
notes: Project proposes a combination of data center, green hydrogen production, and battery storage on a former briquette-factory site in Lobstädt/Neukieritzsch; citizen initiatives failed to block the project because the required quorum was not reached.

name: Blue Future Technologiegebiet Böhlen-Großdeuben hyperscale data center
notes: DataCenter-Insider reports the Blue Future Technologiegebiet Böhlen-Großdeuben project on a 64-hectare site, with up to EUR 1 billion investment, a roughly 400 m long and 20 m high data center, and around 120 jobs.

name: FAB Borna-Süd A72 hyperscale data center
notes: LVZ reports FAB is planning a large/hyperscale data center at the A72 Borna-Süd junction, with the city considering enabling a 37-hectare industrial area adjoining Gewerbegebiet Waldstraße in Zedlitz.

name: Landratsamt Landkreis Leipzig data center modernization
notes: Rittal customer reference describes the Landkreis Leipzig authority, headquartered in Borna, modernizing its data center/IT infrastructure after the district reform.

name: nLighten Leipzig edge data center
notes: Official nLighten page lists the Leipzig edge data center with almost 845 sqm data center area and 1,800 kW end-state site capacity.

name: Penta Infra LEJ01 Leipzig
notes: Penta Infra page describes its Leipzig colocation facility as 1.5 MW, EN 50600 certified, carrier-neutral, with campus expansion planned; DataCenterMap lists Penta LEJ01 as Tier 3+ with 2,800 sqm IT space.

name: euNetworks Leipzig
notes: Third-party directories list euNetworks Leipzig as a colocation facility in the Leipzig market.

name: PŸUR / HLkomm Data Center 1 Leipzig
notes: DataCenterMap lists PŸUR/HLkomm data center facilities in Leipzig, including Data Center 1 HLkomm at Ferdinand-Rhode-Str. 2.

name: Glaubitz B98 technology area data center
developer: Leipzig project developer / FAB-linked press reports
notes: Sächsische Zeitung reports a Leipzig firm is planning a technology area near Glaubitz on the B98, with a data center as the core element.

name: envia TEL Datacenter Leipzig I
notes: Although branded as Leipzig, the campus is in Taucha, Landkreis Nordsachsen; official envia TEL and eco pages describe colocation services and two certified data centers at the Taucha campus near Leipzig.

name: envia TEL Datacenter Leipzig II expansion
notes: DCD/Telecompaper report expansion of Leipzig 2 at the Taucha campus, adding about 1,000 sqm for up to 20,000 additional servers, with first customers expected in summer 2025; campus totals 3,000 sqm and about 60,000 servers.

name: AM:PM Grund Rackwitz / Zschortau 500 MW data center campus
notes: Reports describe a planned 500 MW campus on about 44 hectares at the Zschortau industrial park in Rackwitz, with modular buildings, on-site substation, possible BESS, EUR 4-6 billion investment, and target launch around 2030.

name: Sebnitz secure-storage data center
notes: Sächsische Zeitung archive headline reports a data center being created in Sebnitz for secure storage; details are limited/paywalled and current operating status could not be verified from public snippets.
